correctness.rationale: Read full normal-form proof and axioms. P1--P4 force top/bottom rows, atomic rows equal 1 for upper consequent and a single h(i) otherwise. Semicomplementation restricts h(i) to 0 or a_j with j≠i. P5 applied at antecedent c excludes middle c in coatom row and requires q_c(h(i))=h(i), so S avoids the nonzero image. Conversely row image-fixedness proves P5 and the other axioms. Double-negation inflation forces every nonzero h arrow to be a 2-cycle; pair choices and two independent statuses for each unmatched atom yield exp(2z+z²/2) and F_m. Independent code built every allowed full lattice operation and checked ALL P1..P5, identity, semicomplementation and double-negation through m=4, giving (2,2),(9,5),(76,14),(937,43), and checked T5=15006,F5=142 by formula. These finite checks corroborate but do not replace proof for all m.
residual_risks: Full exhaustive verification is bounded to four atoms and depends on exact adopted P1--P5 normalizations.
Formula uses 0^0=1 at m=s; quotient counting is under automorphisms of the fixed lattice, not all abstract preconditional isomorphisms.
